chunks: I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) saying: “The zanādiqah will appear in the year one hundred and twenty-eight, and that is because I looked into the Muṣḥaf of Fāṭimah (عليها السلام).” He said: I said, “And what is the Muṣḥaf of Fāṭimah?”

He said: “When Allah, the Exalted, took His Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله), there entered upon Fāṭimah (عليها السلام), due to his passing, such grief as none knows except Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. So Allah sent to her an angel to console her sorrow and speak to her. She mentioned that to Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام), and he said: ‘When you sense that and hear the voice, tell me.’”

So she informed him of that, and Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) began writing everything that he heard until he compiled from that a Muṣḥaf. He said: Then he said: ‘Indeed, there is nothing in it of the halal and the haram, but in it is the knowledge of what will be.’”

key_terms.الزَّنَادِقَةُ: those described here as heretics who would appear in a specified year
key_terms.الْحَلَالِ وَالْحَرَامِ: legal categories of what is permissible and forbidden, which the Muṣḥaf did not contain
key_terms.عِلْمُ مَا يَكُونُ: knowledge of what is going to happen in the future
key_terms.غَمَّهَا: her sorrow and grief after the Prophet’s passing
key_terms.مَلَكًا: an angel sent by Allah to console and speak to her
key_terms.مُصْحَفِ فَاطِمَةَ: the written compilation associated with Fāṭimah (عليها السلام)

ai.seo_question: What is the Muṣḥaf of Fāṭimah (عليها السلام) according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the Muṣḥaf of Fāṭimah (عليها السلام) as a written record produced after the passing of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله), through what an angel conveyed to console her and what Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) wrote down. It clarifies that this Muṣḥaf did not contain halal and haram rulings, but rather knowledge of future events.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Umar Bin Abdul Aziz, from Hammad Bin Usman who said, 
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘الزَّنَادِقَةُ’’ The Atheists will appear in the year one hundred and twenty-eight, and that is what I<sup>asws</sup> (found when I<sup>asws</sup>) looked into the Parchment of (Syeda) Fatima<sup>asws</sup>’. I said, ‘And what is the Parchment of Syeda Fatima<sup>asws</sup>?’

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When Allah<sup>azwj</sup> - The Exalted Captured (the soul of) His<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, the grief entered into (Syeda) Fatima<sup>asws</sup> due to his<sup>saww</sup> passing away, (such grief) which none knows it except for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Sent an Angel to her<sup>asws</sup> to console her<sup>asws</sup> sadness and to narrate to her<sup>asws</sup>. So she<sup>asws</sup> described that to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When you<sup>asws</sup> feel that and hear the voice, tell me<sup>asws</sup>’.

So she<sup>asws</sup> let him<sup>asws</sup> know of that, and Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> went on to write down everything what he<sup>asws</sup> heard until a Parchment was affirmed from that’. 
He (the narrator) said, ‘Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But, there isn’t anything in it from the Permissible and the Prohibitions, but therein is the knowledge what is going to happen’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Umar ibn ‘Abd al-‘Aziz from ibn ‘Uthman who has said that he heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say the following. “The heretics will appear in the year one hundred twenty eight (745/746AD) because I have found it in the Mushaf of Fatima (a.s.).” The narrator has said that he asked the Imams (a.s.), “What is Mushaf of Fatime?”

The Imams (a.s.) said, “When Allah took the Holy Prophet (s.a.) from this world, it caused such a degree of grief to Fatima (a.s.) that only Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, knows its extent. Allah then sent an angel to her to offer solace and speak to her. She complained about it to Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) who asked her to inform him whenever she would find the angel speak to her.

She then informed him when the angel came to speak. Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) then would write down all that he would hear of the conversations of the angel so much so that his notes took the shape of a whole book.” The Imam (a.s.) then said, “There was nothing in it of the knowledge of the lawful and unlawful matters but it had the knowledge of things that had happened and things to happen in future.” :
